items.title: persistMode now applies to geofence crossings
items.description: persistMode only ever gated ordinary GPS fixes, so 'location' and 'none' still wrote every geofence ENTER/EXIT to the local database and uploaded it in the next HTTP batch. An app that chose 'none' to get callbacks without the SDK retaining a location history was accumulating a record of every fence it crossed. Crossings are now stored only under 'all' and 'geofence'. Your onGeofence listener is unaffected in every mode — only the database write is gated.
